name: ledge
title_zh: 长任务进行到哪一步，它替你实时写进笔记
tagline_zh: 不用你开口汇报，它把检查项打勾、发现追加成一条持续更新的流水账。适合你忙到忘了自己做到哪、又怕漏记关键转折的活儿。
tagline_en: No need to report—it ticks checklist items and appends findings into a live feed. For when you're too deep in.
desc_en: Keep a Ledge note updated as a live progress feed for a long task — create the note, add and tick checklist items, append findings. Use when the user asks to be kept posted on progress, wants a task tracked in their notes, or mentions Ledge notes.
why_zh: 它把「进度」变成笔记里一条可回看的活记录，而不是聊天记录里被冲散的碎片。每次勾选都留下痕迹。
why_en: It turns progress into a revisable living note, not chat fragments that wash away. Every tick leaves a trace—when the long task.
limit_zh: 只认 Ledge 笔记体系，不接其他笔记软件。它负责写和勾，不负责提醒你该干活了——你忘了推进，它不会催。
limit_en: Only works with Ledge notes, not other note apps. It writes and ticks—it won't remind you to work. Output is note entries, not Gantt charts or.
title_en: Live progress feed for long tasks, written into your notes
